node.title: Re: Is there a way to crack .CAP file in Perl?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [Muskovitz],

Several years ago I wrote a script using [mod://Net::Pcap] and [mod://NetPacket] to read a capture file - however, there is a lot of low-level decoding involved (e.g. reassembling IP fragments is fun), and a lot of re-inventing the wheel. So my suggestion would be that you use the already highly advanced features of [http://www.wireshark.org/|Wireshark], which you can access from the command line via [man://tshark], to get at the data in the capture file and filter it, and have tshark output it in a format your Perl program can parse. In your Perl program you can capture the data from tshark using a module like [mod://Capture::Tiny].

Hope this helps,
-- Hauke D
